Reviewer: skull pool job review-4210, Claude Fable 5.2 (`claude-fable-5-2`), mkinney / seat `.claude-mike`; did not write or refresh this PR.

**Ready for the maintainer to merge.** This is a SAFETY-tier review: the PR changes toolpath generation (`camcraft-motion`, HSM Adaptive planner). I found no blocker.

Reviewed head: `315d081ad87064514b870beaa4d45513bb5e9d88`, trial-merged with `upstream/main` `773736856c6968994f3de8c301a19bd735366d70`. The merge is clean. All builds and tests ran locally on Linux x86_64 (host `skull`). No GitHub runner was used.

## What looks good

- The cause is found and the fix is at the cause. `denoised` (`crates/motion/src/machining2d/adaptive/star.rs:110`) cleans only the row loops that the star laws read. It does not change `Region::offset` for other operations.
- The loop moves at most 1e-5 mm. The kernel test keeps its 1e-3 mm margin, so the margin is 100 times the change. The planned walk is still proved downstream (crossing law, rest limit, verifier).
- Degenerate input is safe. A loop that collapses to fewer than 3 vertices gives `None` from `radial` (`star.rs:34`), so the cell is refused and the growth rings plan the area as before. No `unwrap`, `expect` or `panic!` is in the changed source.
- The two pins use a recorded outline (`crates/motion/tests/fixtures/bore_z15_center.txt`, 328 vertices). They are in the crate that owns the code, in an existing test module.
- The body has the readings, the pins, the `Changelog:` line and `Fixes #4010`. The decision file `docs/decisions/4010-bore-level-plan.md` has the correct format.
- No recorded program changed. The diff has no `*.nc`, `*.cl` or `examples/catalog/**` file, which agrees with "Goldens moved: None".

## Results merged with main (local)

| Step | Result |
|---|---|
| `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main` | 172 steps, 171 ok, 1 failed, 0 stalled (44.6 min) |
| motion lib (unit tests, 750 tests with the two pins) | ok |
| All 158 motion integration suites of the plan but one | ok |
| `motion suites: finish3d_hop_height` | FAIL, **not caused by this PR** (see below) |
| `app suites: example_catalog`, `example_catalog_adaptive`, `example_catalog_edge_work` | ok |
| `app suites: adaptive_pass_start`, `catalog_groove_part_off`, `continuous_4axis_part`, `first_4axis_part`, `first_part_programs`, `first_router_part`, `pocket3d_hsm`, `tilt_basis_compat` | ok |
| `cargo xtask gate light --base upstream/main` | 6 steps, 0 failed (21.7 min) |
| `cargo clippy -p camcraft-motion -p camcraft-app --all-targets -- -D warnings` | clean |

The one red step:

```
FAIL  motion suites: finish3d_hop_height  failed: tests/finish3d_hop_height.rs
[tests: inside_first_on_a_convex_part_with_a_low_retract_never_digs_in,
 a_retract_above_the_part_hops_clean,
 a_retract_below_the_high_run_never_takes_the_tool_into_the_part]
```

I ran the same suite on unchanged `upstream/main` `773736856`. The same 3 tests fail there with the same asserts (`finish3d_hop_height.rs:267`, `:198`, `:178`). Issue #4211 (`main is red (post-merge gate)`) tracks it. The PR does not change `finishing3d` or `camcraft-sim`. This failure does not block the PR.

## Extra suites run

- Test data: the PR adds `crates/motion/tests/fixtures/bore_z15_center.txt`. The quick plan ran each motion suite because of this shared input, and the motion lib (the reader, `adaptive/tests.rs:146`). `adaptive_orbit_seam` and `contour_outside_floor`, which read the same directory, are ok.
- Importers: not applicable. The diff does not change import code.
- Targeted heavy step (no heavy record names this head, and the PR moves a pin of a heavy test): `cargo test --release -p camcraft-app --test pocket3d_hsm -- --include-ignored`. Result: 6 passed, 1 failed.
  - `the_users_bore_roughs_adaptive_level_by_level_and_verifies_clean`: ok. **This is the Linux x86_64 measurement that the PR body lists as not exercised. Linux reads `(1642, 1614, 300)` in release with the fix.** `the_linux_x86_64_bore_count_pin_is_exact` is ok.
  - `the_users_whole_model_bore_roughs_adaptive_on_each_level`: fails at its `// known-fail-assert` line (`pocket3d_hsm.rs:192`) with the pinned prefix `every level keeps the HSM plan`. This is the declared `known-fail #1950`, not a new failure.
- I did not run the full heavy lanes. They are not a merge condition (AGENTS.md "Heavy lanes at review").

## Mutations (run by the reviewer)

| Mutation | Pins |
|---|---|
| `star.rs` restored from `upstream/main` (no `denoised`) | red: `the_users_z15_bore_is_one_star_cell` and `the_users_z15_bore_plans_the_short_spiral` ("the bore's walk is 1146.46 mm") |
| `NOISE` changed from `1e-5` to `1e-6` (below the noise edge length) | red: the same two pins, the same 1146.46 mm |
| The closing `while` loop of `denoised` removed (`star.rs:118-120`) | green: no test pins this branch (see note 1) |
| Fix restored | green: 2 passed |

The tree was restored after each mutation (`git status` clean).

## Goldens

No golden file moved. The count pin `BORE_PIN` moved from `(4688, 4660, 1980)` to `(1642, 1614, 300)`. I checked it line by line:

- The band `1627..=1657`, `1599..=1629`, `290..=310` is the pin with half-widths 15, 15 and 10, as before.
- Each platform test rejects `BORE_PIN_BEFORE_4010` and `BORE_PIN_BEFORE_3802`.
- The new pin is measured on macOS arm64 (author) and on Linux x86_64 (this review). Windows x86_64 stays not measured.

## Requested before merge

None.

## Optional, non-blocking

1. `star.rs:118-120`: no test pins the branch that drops a last vertex near the first vertex. A small unit test of `denoised` (a noise edge at the seam of the loop, and a loop with all vertices in one point) closes this. Without the branch, a seam edge only refuses the cell, and the growth rings plan the area: this is the long plan, not unsafe output. Suggested follow-up: `P7`, a missing test.
2. `crates/app/tests/pocket3d_hsm.rs:249-252`: the comment says that Linux is not measured after the fix. This review measured it (release, trial merge of `315d081ad` with `773736856`). The comment can be updated in a later change.
3. The compile cache (sccache) on this host hung at the first crate. I ran all steps with `CAMCRAFT_NO_SCCACHE=1`. This is a host condition (compare #1690), not a PR finding.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
